children.text: Design mode keeps the plain selection and the inspector

Sits above whatever is selected in Vibe and only offers what the design system has: a component's own props, the text styles, the colour, radius and spacing tokens. Every control is a select showing its value alone; the menu it opens says which prop or token it sets. The selection's name sits on its edge, not in the toolbar.
Four parts, always in this order, so the agent button is found in the same place whatever is selected.
The selection's name. Its menu walks up to the parents and down to the children.
Props first, then tokens. The value alone; the prop's name heads the menu and the tooltip.
One square, in the agents' pink. Attached, it turns into the chat mark and opens the thread.
Copy link, copy ID, the rest of the right-click menu.

Three colours, each with one meaning. Blue is a plain element: a row, a column, a group, a text, an image. Purple is a component of the library, since what it offers is its props. Pink is an agent, whichever one: its button, its work on an element, its status in the chat. The tag names the agent, the colour does not change with it.
A component's props as its code declares them (cva variants, sizes, the icon slot), each a select, whatever the count. The menu previews each value drawn with the real component.
Two selects at most, then + n: the popover lists every prop the toolbar leaves out, so a component with twenty options stays one line.
Every prop, typed, is in Design mode
The text styles of the design system, a text colour token and the alignment. Size and weight on their own are Design mode edits.
Rows, columns and groups: fill, radius, padding, gap and shadow, each a token of the theme, named as the Tailwind class it becomes.
What they share: alignment, the gap between them, wrapping them. All of them go to the chat at once.

children.text: In the chat, and being changed

An element attached to a thread says so on its edge. While an agent changes it, the element turns pink, whichever agent it is, a light passes through it and the parts being rewritten turn to skeletons; its name and what it is doing sit on the edge. This replaces the strip at the bottom of the canvas.
